findings.claim: The memory-retention decision remains underspecified despite being treated as a resolved first-release control.
findings.evidence: The Analyze handoff requires Plan to "resolve schedule/DST/delivery/retention/supervisor details." The plan specifies "Automatic assistant memory capture is opt-in and requires explicit retention selection," and change 13 says "Require explicit retention choice at enablement," but neither defines permitted retention values, the timestamp from which retention runs, or whether a policy change applies to existing memories. Its acceptance criterion "expire during retrieval" therefore has no defined expiration rule to test.
findings.suggested_fix: Define the first-release retention input contract, including allowed durations or indefinite retention, the expiration anchor, and the effect of policy revisions on existing and queued captures. Add exact boundary and policy-change acceptance scenarios to change 13.
